Name: NPC_SYS_MSG_PARAM_ST
Description: System notification messages: which TalkParam line to show, its priority, how many times it can be shown and the minimum interval between showings.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Talk Param ID
Fields.Description: Last 3 digits of the TalkParam row to use.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Priority of the message. Lower values take priority.

Fields.Name: Message Display Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum number of times the message is shown.

Fields.Name: Message Display Interval
Fields.Description: Minimum message display interval, in seconds.
